entities.name: UE requested PDN disconnection procedure
entities.description: Procedure for a UE to request disconnection from one PDN. Releases all EPS bearer contexts established towards this PDN, including the default EPS bearer context.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection not supported
entities.description: Condition where UE or MME does not support EMM-REGISTERED state without PDN connection.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection supported
entities.description: Condition where both UE and MME support EMM-REGISTERED state without PDN connection.

entities.name: T3396
entities.description: Timer related to PDN connectivity procedures.

entities.name: EPS bearer contexts release
entities.description: Property where all EPS bearer contexts established towards the PDN, including the default EPS bearer context, are released.

relations.description: PDN disconnection procedure requires UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state.
When EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported, UE can initiate procedure only if connected to at least one other PDN.
When EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is supported, UE can initiate procedure to disconnect from any PDN.
PDN disconnection procedure results in release of all EPS bearer contexts for the PDN.
UE can initiate PDN disconnection procedure even if timer T3396 is running.
